name: RATIONAL
group: Hangzhou Denova (Dinova) Neuro Medtech, 杭州德诺脑神经医疗科技有限公司; co-developed with Beijing Tiantan Hospital (Gao Feng team)
versions: RATIONAL surgical control system (company promo); registered as Cerebrovascular Interventional Procedural Control System (NCT05972252)
devices_driven: 4: microguidewire, microcatheter, aspiration catheter, stent retriever; guide/aspiration catheters inserted manually
validation_detail: 10 pts first-in-human, Beijing Tiantan, Oct 2023-Jun 2024 (yang2025_use); trial NCT05972252, start 2023-10-15, Beijing Tiantan Hospital (clinicaltrials2023_nct05972252)
key_numbers: mTICI 3 in 8, 2b in 2; puncture-to-reperfusion 65.10+-22.23 min (robotic 13.70+-5.18, manual 51.40+-20.16); console dose 0.18+-0.11 vs 59.21+-52.57 uSv; 90-day mRS<=2 in 7; technician device exchange = main limitation
